newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Concord to spin off property div.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Concord to spin off property div.

text.p: Pacific Concord Holding Ltd said on Thursday it planned to spin off its Hong Kong and China property division and to seek a separate listing for the unit.

The plan will proceed by way of a subscription and sale of shares of the unit, Concord Land Development Co Ltd, to institutional and professional investors and to the public in Hong Kong, Pacific Concord said in a statement.
A listing for the unit would be sought in Hong Kong.
Concord Land will acquire certain property development and investment assets now held by Pacific Concord and its chairman Wong Sai Chung valued at HK$7.7 billion as at August 28.
After the acquisition but prior to the share offer and proposed share listing, Pacific Concord will hold 91.9 percent of the issued share capital of Concord Land.
The company said it could not yet give the number of shares to be issued, their price or the timing of the issue and listing.
After the listing, Pacific Concord will hold about 75 percent of the issued share capital of Concord Land.
The acquisition of assets will be satisfied by Concord Land by the issue of new shares, credited as fully paid.

Wheelock Natwest Securities Ltd has been appointed the global coordinator for the share offer and sponsor for the proposed listing. The spin-off is subject to the approval of the company's shareholders and from various authorities, he said.
